title: CI Job Report
description: Schema for the {job}-report.json artifact uploaded by CI steps for the Governance Engine.

job.description: The name of the CI job (e.g., build, lint, static, test, security).

status.description: The overall status of the CI job.

reports.description: Detailed list of verbose reports for specific rules, tasks, or checks within this job.

name.description: The name of the specific rule, task, or check.

status.description: The status of this specific rule or check.

comment.description: A comment, output, or detailed feedback regarding the result of the rule.
